name: @tpmjs/tools-web-research
description: The everyday research kit: read any page as markdown, search the web through your preferred provider, ask Perplexity with citations, find Wayback snapshots and search archive.org

env.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
env.description: Firecrawl key for webSearch (one of the search keys is required for webSearch)

env.name: BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY
env.description: Brave Search API key for webSearch

env.name: JINA_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Jina key for higher readPage rate limits

tools.name: readPage
tools.description: Fetch a web page and return its readable content as markdown (title, text, links), with length control.

tools.name: webSearch
tools.description: Search the web through the first configured provider (Firecrawl, Brave, Serper or Tavily) and return normalised results.

tools.name: askPerplexity
tools.description: Ask Perplexity (sonar) a research question and get a sourced answer with citations.

tools.name: waybackSnapshot
tools.description: Find the closest Wayback Machine snapshot of a URL, optionally near a date.

tools.name: archiveSearch
tools.description: Search the Internet Archive catalog (books, texts, audio, video) and return items with identifiers and links.
